load_prompt_template: load a named prompt template from prompts directory and substitute placeholders with provided values
load_combined_knowledge: load combined domain knowledge by concatenating knowledge and platform prompt directories
load_prompt_directory: load and concatenate all markdown files under a prompt subdirectory recursively
render_phase_prompt: render a phase prompt template like analyze or headspace with KNOWLEDGE and PIPELINE_CODE substitutions
assemble_agent_context: assemble workflow agent context by loading knowledge and platform prompt directories together
